alt: 社區活動的協調者熱情介紹園丁與老師認識，鄰居帶著澆水壺加入，眾人開始合作規劃花園。
scene_prompt: Contemporary community courtyard. A warm, socially skilled adult organizer introduces a gardener carrying seedlings to a teacher holding a blank community garden model while another neighbor joins with a watering can. Their eye contact, open gestures and emerging cooperative garden plan convey an ability to connect people and opportunities rather than literal long-sleeve dancing. Exactly four adults; natural limbs, grips and ground contact.
